name: monitor
description: System monitoring tool for multiple computers — local, SSH, EC2.

serviceSurfaces.name: http-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: monitor-server serves a local REST/SSE surface today, but it declares neither GET /ready nor GET /version and ships no generated SDK, so it is not yet a contract-supported API surface.

serviceSurfaces.name: typescript-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: No client SDK is generated while the HTTP API surface is deferred; consumers import ./src/index.ts directly.

waivedStorageEngines.reason: src/db/postgres-adapter.ts exists but cannot serve traffic: its runSync helper busy-waits with Bun.sleepSync, which blocks the event loop the pending query needs, so every call times out after 30s. Declaring postgres as a supported engine would be false until that adapter is rewritten async-first.

conformanceBaseline.reason: The two pending bin renames below are owner-blocked breaking changes, so `bun run contract-check` still fails one check. This baseline is what `bun run contract-baseline` holds the authority to in CI: exactly these failures pass, anything else — a new failure, a changed detail, or a baseline entry that stops failing — breaks the build. Remove an entry as soon as its cause is resolved.

failures.detail: in package.json but undeclared: monitor-server, monitor-web

pendingBinRenames.reason: Ships in package.json bin but falls outside the contract bin allowlist, so it cannot be declared above. The allowlisted equivalent already exists as the `monitor serve` subcommand; dropping the standalone bin is a breaking change to a published package and needs an owner decision.

Ships in package.json bin but falls outside the contract bin allowlist, and no allowlisted bin name fits a dashboard dev server. Replacing it needs a new `monitor web` subcommand plus an owner decision on the breaking change.
